cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Successful Compliance
cards.instruction: Describe a failed outcome as proof that the correct process was followed and therefore the system worked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Our evacuation drill followed all seventeen instructions perfectly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then everyone reached the designated assembly point and nobody wandered off. Full compliance.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can't reach the door handle with all twelve of us in here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All twelve accounted for, with nobody able to leave before the headcount. That's both final checks passed.
